name: creanose-movil
description: Vistas del ciudadano (APP-V01..V10) del prototipo Escombro 0 — HTML + CSS tokens + TS ligero de maquetado

scripts.copy: cp -r src/assets dist/ && mkdir -p dist/movil dist/web && cp src/views/movil/*.html dist/ && cp src/views/movil/*.html dist/movil/ && (cp src/views/web/*.html dist/web/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build: pnpm run css && pnpm run js && pnpm run copy
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && npx serve dist
